open.speaker: sf_arcade_man
lines: sf_arcade_man
Change for a pound, no notes in the falls, and if the claw drops it, it's dropped. Len Garside. I own the noise.
sf_arcade_man
You're the ones been in Colin's booth. Ten pence, was it? He gives it you for ten pence and I've given him twenty-one years of rent-free.
dale
Every machine in here is tilted a hair toward the sea. I'd bet the floor's gone, not the machines.

passives.line: He put the ten pence sign up. He said so before you asked. A man who confesses to a joke is keeping the thing that isn't one.
The penny falls on the end are 1973 stock and they are the only machines in here he has not replaced. Nobody keeps a loser that long for the takings.

options.text: Rent-free's a good rate. What's the catch?
He's a good booth man. Everyone says so.
We're not here for the falls, Mr Garside.

wry.speaker: sf_arcade_man
lines: sf_arcade_man
The catch is he's Colin. You get the story with the change, and the coach parties come for the story and stay for the falls.
sf_arcade_man
Nobody on this pier loses on Colin Rudd. That's the catch.

kind.speaker: sf_arcade_man
lines: sf_arcade_man
Best on the south coast. Never short, never late, never drunk on the boards. I've had lads from Portsmouth couldn't say the same.
sf_arcade_man
He's a good lad. He was a good lad at eight and all. That's what nobody puts in the paper.

hard.speaker: sf_arcade_man
lines: sf_arcade_man
No. You're here for 1973, same as the Chronicle, same as the two in suits, same as the woman with the card.
sf_arcade_man
Fine. You get it the same as the kiddies. Short, and over the counter.

hub.speaker: sf_arcade_man
hub.prompt: Ask. The claw's doing a line of kids and I've a float to count.
lines: sf_arcade_man
Ask. The claw's doing a line of kids and I've a float to count.

static.line: The falls on the end. Listen to them. There's a coin in there that has been sliding since 1973 and it has never dropped. Ask him why he keeps them.

options.text: What's Colin like when the pier's shut and there's no one to tell it to?

fail.line: Same as anyone. Goes home. Don't make him a case, he's a man with a booth.

options.text: Pirates, a gorilla, a wizard. The wizard never took the hat off. Did he ever speak?
Terry Gosling told us. The ten pence sign was his idea. Make it a joke and nobody files it.
This hat. From the camp store. Is it the wizard's?
We'll leave you to the float.

colin_after.speaker: sf_arcade_man
lines: sf_arcade_man
Sits on the end rail. Every night, when I've cashed up. Looks at the Levels, not the sea. I've asked him what he's looking for and he says the hut.
sf_arcade_man
He says it like you'd say the bus. Twenty-one years and he still thinks it's coming.
elijah
He's not watching for it. He's keeping it company.

wizard_voice.speaker: sf_arcade_man
lines: sf_arcade_man
Once. A kiddie dropped her pennies and he picked them up and said 'that's the way to do it' in a voice like a tin whistle. Flat. No breath in it.
sf_arcade_man
The kiddie cried. He laughed, out of the hat, and he had a mouth-organ in his sleeve, I saw the shine of it.
june
A tin voice. That's not a throat, that's a reed. The Punch man on the beach would know what.

wizard_fail.speaker: sf_arcade_man
lines: sf_arcade_man
Did he speak? It was 1973 and the falls were going. Nobody spoke, son, you couldn't hear yourself lose.
sf_arcade_man
Try the deckchair man. Wilf. Nothing moves on that beach without Wilf writing it in a book.

sign.speaker: sf_arcade_man
lines: sf_arcade_man
...Terry said that? Terry said it. All right. 1985. He came in white as the float and said make it a turn, Len, make it ten pence, make it funny.
sf_arcade_man
Because Fay Mallory had been up at the camp that summer, and she'd found something, and Terry wanted it a joke before it was a thing.
sf_arcade_man
Colin never knew it was Terry's idea. He thought it was mine. I let him. Put that in your file and see how it reads.
teddy
The joke was built. Somebody ordered it, like the set.

bluff_fail.speaker: sf_arcade_man
lines: sf_arcade_man
Terry Gosling hasn't set foot on this pier since the donkey. If he told you anything he told you from the bingo, and that's a long shout.
sf_arcade_man
You've had your change. Go and lose it.

hat_shown.speaker: sf_arcade_man
lines: sf_arcade_man
...That's it. Sun and moon were on the front, they've worn. That's it and I've not seen it since the Tuesday.
sf_arcade_man
The falls on the end. The ones I never changed. There's a penny in there from that week with a notch filed in it, and he put it in, and it's never dropped.
sf_arcade_man
I could tip the machine. I've never tipped the machine.
vera
He's kept the machine as an altar and never once admitted what to.
